summary: Admin secret persisted in localStorage — XSS-stealable and survives across sessions
scenario: Any XSS on the admin origin (or shared/kiosk machine) reads localStorage['yfitops_admin_secret'] -> exfiltrates ADMIN_SECRET (== VITE_STAGE_SECRET), the crown-jewel trusted-role credential, granting full game control.
suggested_fix: Keep the secret only in-memory (secretRef/state); do not persist to localStorage. If session-resume is required, use a short-lived server-issued session token instead of the raw admin secret.

summary: Client readLoop enforces no max-frame cap (server framing.go caps at 1 MiB)
code:
const len = new DataView(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset, 4).getUint32(0, false);
if (buf.length < 4 + len) break;
scenario: A corrupt or hostile 4-byte length prefix (e.g. 0xFFFFFFFF) makes the client wait to buffer up to ~4 GiB before dispatching, unbounded memory growth / hang — the server's symmetric maxFrameLen (1<<20) guard is missing on the client.
suggested_fix: Mirror server maxFrameLen: after reading len, if (len > 1<<20) close the stream / throw instead of buffering.

summary: Builder mutation handlers lack try/catch — failed API calls silently fail, no error surfaced, UI left stale
code: const handleDeleteTrack = async (trackId) => { if (!selectedId) return; await api.deleteTrack(selectedId, trackId); refresh(); };
scenario: Server returns 500/4xx (or connection drops) on delete/toggle/addColumn/removeColumn -> await rejects -> refresh() never runs and no error UI shows -> unhandled promise rejection; host believes the edit applied while board diverges from server truth.
suggested_fix: Wrap each handler body in try/catch, surface the error to the user, and call refresh() in a finally so the UI reconciles with server state on failure.

summary: Cross-cell drag does unplace-then-place non-atomically; a failed second call silently drops the track from the board
scenario: Moving a track between cells: unplaceTrack succeeds, placeTrack then fails (500/network) -> track is removed from its cell but never re-placed; refresh() shows it back in the holding area with no indication the move failed.
suggested_fix: Prefer a single server-side move endpoint, or on placeTrack failure re-place the track at its original cell (compensating action) and surface an error.
